g.text: Parabolic vertical curves connect grades while PVC, PVI, and PVT locate the geometry

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Two separate equal-tangent teaching curves; entering/exiting grades are decimals in the equation and differ by5 percentage points. PVI is on the intersecting
tangents, not on the parabola. Actual maximum/minimum occurs where curve grade is zero, not necessarily at midlength. Geometry only; stopping/headlight sight
distance and comfort criteria are not checked.
